images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. First-person sensory-deprivation detective game: the screen is almost black, a dark study of an old Korean hillside house barely visible as faint charcoal line silhouettes of bookshelves, a desk and a window. Over it float horizontal strata of luminous colored haze, stacked like sediment layers in the air, each a soft glowing band of scent: burnt-orange citrus detergent at the top, an olive-and-slate alcohol band visibly muddied and hatched where two people's scents mix, grey smoke, mauve sweat, warm leather brown, cool blue-grey ether, a thin rust-red iron band at the bottom. Faint rising smoke wisps. Left of each band a small serif label, right a short attribution. Top-left an elegant light serif title and a row of breath dots, half used. Right: dark panels listing five household suspects as glowing colored scent orbs, and purity meters stuck below a threshold tick. Bottom: a small house graph and a reconstruction timeline grid with dots. Korean UI text: "냄새의 층", "서재", "들이쉰다". Palette: umber black, amber gold highlights, muted smoky pigments; film grain, heavy vignette, hushed and intimate. Text constraints: the five suspects are exactly "가정부 윤씨", "정원사 배씨", "찬모 한씨", "왕진 온 의사", "집주인의 아들"; band attributions use only these labels; the only time shown is "밤 11:27" with no year or date.

images.screen: B · 갈라진 층 — 되돌아오니 남의 냄새가 가라앉고 한 층이 또렷해져 시각이 선다
images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. Same first-person dark study made of faint charcoal line silhouettes, two hours later. The scent strata have changed: the top citrus band has almost vanished into darkness, while the alcohol band has separated and turned into a single crisp brilliant pale-gold ribbon of light glowing with bloom, clearly pure; the other bands (leather, ether, iron) remain as softer smoky layers. A tilted gold-bordered stamp card overlaps the upper area announcing the reconstructed fact with a serif headline. Right panels: purity meter filled to 100% in gold, a remaining-strength meter, and a gold-edged explanation box; breath dots almost all spent. Bottom: a reconstruction timeline grid where a new gold dot pulses in the study row at 19:00, one crossed red mark for a fact lost forever, and a small house map with the next room highlighted. Korean UI text: "되짚었다", "19:00 · 집주인의 아들", "새긴다". Palette: near-black umber, warm gold bloom, muted smoky pigments; film grain, vignette, a quiet epiphany mood. Visual constraints: the room stays almost black and is drawn only as faint charcoal line silhouettes of an old Korean hillside house study (plain bookshelves, low desk, paper-latticed window); no fireplace, no European furniture, no coat of arms or crest on the stamp card; the gold scent ribbon is the brightest element on screen.
